source_text: In a 2023 Sudanese study of 200 rural women, those with FGM scored significantly lower on FSFI domains (mean total score 18.4 vs. 26.7 for non-FGM; p<0.001), with pronounced impairments in desire, satisfaction, and pain subscales across types I-III. [40]
